title: Coatue joins OpenAI's $1.25 trillion-valuation round

sources.quote: Investors participating in the first tranche include Coatue Management and T. Rowe Price.

explain: Coatue is reported to be in the first tranche, about $11 billion, of OpenAI's new funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation. Coatue's own amount was not disclosed, and the report is based on Bloomberg's anonymous sources.
